name: MxEndMix
comment: Reads and decodes the next block of a sound through the file layer Original name MxEndMix (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): converts the mix buffer to 16-bit output through the soft limiter table (mixBuf, outChannelCount, softLTable) and feeds the recorder (recordState), as the remaster's MxEndMix); was Im_ReadSoundData.

name: ihost_read
comment: Original name ihost_read (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the iMUSE host read callback: per-sound file handle table, voice sound 10000 with useVoxFx measures the file by seeking to the end, as the remaster's ihost_read); was FUN_10007ca0.
